description: This file defines the RefreshValue class, which implements the <refresh-value> element of the MiniLang simple method framework in OFBiz. It handles refreshing a GenericValue entity object based on configuration provided in the XML element.

classes.name: RefreshValue
classes.description: Implements the <refresh-value> element, which refreshes a specific GenericValue entity in the database.

classes.name: RefreshValueFactory
classes.description: Factory class to create instances of RefreshValue from XML elements.

methods.name: RefreshValue
methods.description: Constructor initializing RefreshValue with XML element and method context, validating attributes.

methods.name: exec
methods.description: Executes the refresh operation on the specified entity value within the method context.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the refresh-value element.

methods.name: createMethodOperation
methods.description: Factory method creating a RefreshValue instance from an XML element.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the name of the XML element this factory creates ('refresh-value').
